The first run of the programme. The materials of this cohort are the **PDF
slides** that were uploaded to Ilias, listed below in teaching order with the
day each one was added to the repository. The slide sources were revised
afterwards for the 2024/25 cohort, so the interactive decks on this site do not
reproduce these PDFs; the sources as they stood for this cohort are linked
under each PDF.

## Sources

The last content change for this cohort is commit
[`9c5d2e6`](https://github.com/EBukin/mk68-2023-24-public/commit/9c5d2e6) of
30 January 2024, "Week 7 slides". The whole `materials/` folder as it stood then
is browsable at
[`tree/9c5d2e6/materials`](https://github.com/EBukin/mk68-2023-24-public/tree/9c5d2e6/materials).
The week decks were rendered with the 2023/24
[`_quarto.yml`](https://github.com/EBukin/mk68-2023-24-public/blob/9c5d2e6/_quarto.yml),
which differed from the 2024/25 one mainly in the subtitle and footer
("Part 2 … WS2023/24") and in having incremental slide builds switched on by
default.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## What changed for 2024/25

Between the two cohorts the sources of every week were revised (2,810 lines
added and 2,413 removed across 28 files). The largest changes were to Week 2,
which was split into separately rendered parts, and to Weeks 4 and 5, whose
PDFs went from 78 and 80 pages to 60 and 99. To see the revised version of a
week, open it from the [2024/25 cohort page](ws-2024-25.qmd).
:::
